name: TCS34725 RGB Color Sensor
fullName: TCS34725 High-Precision I2C RGB Color Sensor with IR Blocking Filter
tagline: Professional RGB and clear light sensor with onboard white illumination LED
description: The TCS34725 is a digital color sensor that integrates an RGB photodiode array with an IR blocking filter. It accurately measures Red, Green, Blue, and Clear (lux) light intensities without optical interference from infrared ambient heat sources.

specs.operatingVoltage: 3.3V to 5V DC (onboard 3.3V regulator and level shifting)
specs.illumination: Onboard 4150°K neutral white LED with LED enable pin (LED / INT)
specs.irFilter: Integrated IR blocking filter minimizes IR spectral component

pinout.name: LED Control
pinout.desc: Pull LOW to turn OFF the onboard white LED

wiringNote: Keep target object 1–3 cm away from the sensor aperture for optimal color recognition.
commonMistakes: Placing target object too far away (>5 cm) causing ambient shadows to distort readings
Confusing TCS34725 (I2C) with TCS3200 (Frequency pulse output)
